John Stuart Mill (20 May 1806 – 7 May 1873) [ 5 ] was an English philosopher , political economist , politician and civil servant. One of the most influential thinkers in the history of liberalism and social liberalism , [ 6 ] [ 7 ] [ 3 ] he contributed widely to social theory , political theory , and political economy. Dubbed "the most influential English-speaking philosopher of the nineteenth century" by the Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy , [ 8 ] he conceived of liberty as justifying the freedom of the individual in opposition to unlimited state and social control . [ 9 ] He advocated political and social reforms such as proportional representation, the emancipation of women, and the development of labour organisations and farm cooperatives.
